featuredProjects.name: EEEA-Py
featuredProjects.description: Led modular architecture, test suite, and the Python-vs-R benchmark study for a package implementing EES (Salinas-Gutiérrez & Muñoz Zavala, 2023) as a population-initialization strategy across EMNA, PSO, and GWO metaheuristics.

evidence.title: EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE
evidence.context: Cross-language benchmark comparing Python and R implementations of EES across 30 independent runs (Sphere function, dim=10).

featuredProjects.name: EvoBench
featuredProjects.description: Python framework for benchmarking evolutionary algorithms against classic n-dimensional test functions.

featuredProjects.name: MNIST Bench
featuredProjects.description: Paired comparison of an MLX-based MLP and a scikit-learn One-vs-One SVM on a stratified 15k-sample subset of MNIST, using 10-fold cross-validation and formal hypothesis testing.

featuredProjects.name: Sleep Staging GNN
featuredProjects.description: M.Sc. thesis proposal: a Graph Neural Network enriched with copula functions to classify sleep stages from EEG while remaining invariant to electrode montage. Advised by Dr. Rogelio Salinas Gutiérrez and Dra. Ivonne Bazán Trujillo, UAA.

featuredProjects.name: Pixiter
featuredProjects.description: Image interpolation comparing global Lagrange with local planes, demonstrating superior numerical stability.
